official_path.name: MissionController Path
official_path.human_gate_support: Full - create_human_gate, decide_human_gate, durable across process kill
official_path.attempt_accounting: Full - E33 verified with attempt_id in TASK_ASSIGNED

legacy_path.name: OperationalMissionPlanner Path
legacy_path.verification_authority: NONE - transitions to VERIFIED with actor='system'
legacy_path.attempt_accounting: NONE - does not use MissionController's attempt tracking

governance_findings.evidence: src/unified/operational.py:944 calls _transition_mission_state to MissionState.VERIFIED, which calls validate_mission_transition with default actor='system', causing ValueError: 'VERIFIED transition requires actor="user"'
governance_findings.impact: If legacy path is used for a successful mission, it will crash at VERIFIED transition

governance_findings.finding: LEGACY PATH NOT USED BY DEFAULT
governance_findings.impact: Official path is MissionController; legacy path only invoked explicitly

governance_findings.finding: LEGACY PATH CANNOT BYPAASS HUMAN GATE
governance_findings.evidence: Legacy path delegates human gate creation/decision to ExecutionEngine which enforces HUMAN_REQUIRED state transitions correctly
governance_findings.impact: Human gate governance preserved even in legacy path

governance_findings.finding: LEGACY PATH HAS NO REPLAN CAPABILITY
governance_findings.evidence: Uses simple OperationalMissionPlanner; no failure detection, classification, or replan logic
governance_findings.impact: Legacy path cannot handle mission deviation - only simple linear missions

governance_findings.evidence: Does not use MissionController's attempt_history tracking; TASK_ASSIGNED events may lack attempt_id context
governance_findings.impact: Audit trail weaker for legacy path executions

verdict.legacy_path_has_critical_bug: VERIFIED transition with actor='system' fails golden rule
verdict.recommendation: Either fix legacy path to stop at EVIDENCED (like MissionController) or remove it entirely. Current state: legacy path is non-functional for successful missions.
